about_the_game:
Intro

This is a short game about a little face who's tired of being so dizzy all the time! Luckily, they find the source of this dizzyness and get to work destroying it from the inner sanctions of their mind. You play as this face, dodge bullets and kill a giant wheel! Its weird and wacky, so if you like that type of thing, totally pick it up!!!

Gameplay

The game itself is as simple as can be: when you start the game and get through the monologue at the beginning, you are presented with a player character that you move around with the arrow keys inside of an area defined by a border, and a giant wheel at the top. this wheel has wedges that each act as their own multi-phase boss. each phase activates bullets spawners, which volley bullets across the screen for you to dodge, and you progress though the game by holding the shoot button [Z] to fire your own bullets at the wedge. if your lives represented by the stars in the top right deplete, its game over. but don't worry! every time you defeat a wedge, you gain a life! The game has some sharp difficulty spikes throughout, you move pretty fast, and there are some surprises all throughout, making for an all-around hectic experience that will leave you pining for the win! you also get a reward if you win, based on your performance. They're nothing special, but make sure to screenshot your reward if you got a good one, because the game doesn't save data across playthroughs.

Making of

This game is a bullet hell inspired by the likes of touhou, and originally meant for the 2025 Boss Rush Game Jam on itch.io! I designed it on the side while working on another submission with a team, and i liked my idea so much i ran with it! I couldnt get it submitted to the jam in time, but 8 months later i finally finished it! This game was almost entirely developed by myself, with some assets being royalty-free like fonts.

I also plan to use some of the stuff i made for this to make a bullet hell maker, so look forward to that!

name: Dizzys

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: 10
  • Processor: x86_32 CPU with SSE2 support, x86_64 CPU with SSE4.2 support, ARMv8 CPU
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Integrated graphics with full Vulkan 1.0 support, Metal 3 support (macOS) or Direct3D 12 (12_0 feature level) support (Windows)
  • Storage: 150 MB available space

short_description: A surreal bullet hell shmup about a face fighting a wheel! Dodge bullets and shoot down an onslaught of 6 difficult hand-animated bosses with carefully curated bullet patterns. battle to hectic music and aim to get hit as little as you can manage in...DIZZYS!!!
